mayabi.name: Rev. Canon Captain Richard W. Mayabi
mayabi.title: Executive Director, Missions Anglicanes Afrique (AMA)

sections.title: Bio
sections.content: Rev. Canon Captain Richard W. Mayabi is the Founder of Missions Anglicanes Afrique (Anglican Missions Africa – AMA). The mission agency seeks to nurture a healthy and sustainable Church in Africa and beyond through leadership development, mission mobilization, and church strengthening initiatives.

sections.title: Work Experience
items: 2019: Director in charge of Capacity Building and Leadership Development at the Council for Anglican Provinces of Africa (CAPA)
2009 – 2018: General Secretary of Church Army Africa
2004 – 2008: Pioneer Parish Priest for ACK St. Jerome and St. Thomas parishes in All Saints Cathedral Diocese
1995 – 2003: Pioneer missionary and church planter in Makueni–Machakos Diocese

sections.title: Educational Background
items: Master of Theology (MTh) in Urban World – International Christian College Glasgow / Aberdeen University
Master of Arts (MA) in Mission Studies – Africa International University (AIU), Nairobi
Post Graduate Diploma (PGD) in Christian Ministries – Africa International University (AIU), Nairobi
Higher Diploma (HDP) in Theology – Carlile College, Church Army Africa
Diploma in Theology – Mission Studies, Exeter University, UK
Diploma in Discipleship Training School (DTS) – Youth With A Mission (YWAM), University of the Nations

sections.title: Family
sections.content: He is married to The Rev. Captain Patience Wanzala, and together they are blessed with three children.

sections.title: Mission Commitment
sections.content: Committed to raising leaders and strengthening the mission of the Church in Africa.

sections.title: Bio
sections.content: Silvia Chepkoech holds a bachelor's degree in Communication and Media from Egerton University. She is ambitious, God-fearing, hardworking, and passionate about photography, videography, graphic design, and social media management. She joined Missions Anglicanes Afrique (AMA) in December 2022 and currently leads communications.

sections.title: Work Experience
items: 2021 – 2023: Communications and Media Manager – Cactus Mama Telemental
2021 – 2022: Radio Presenter – Egerton Radio
2020 – 2021: Videographer – Flicker Productions
2019 – 2020: Script Writer & Voice Over Artist – Jara Media

sections.title: Skills & Expertise
items: Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Strong interpersonal skills and relationship-building ability
Knowledge of media production, including audio/video recording and editing
Familiarity with social media platforms and strategies
Understanding of mass communication theories and principles
Ability to analyze and interpret communication/media trends
Proficiency in creating and executing communication plans and campaigns
Skills in graphic design and visual storytelling
Knowledge of ethical considerations in communication and media
Ability to work independently and in a team
Adaptability to new technologies and emerging trends in communication

sections.title: Bio
sections.content: Televangelist Kaindi Joseph is a distinguished journalist, media expert, and evangelist in the Anglican Church of Kenya. Renowned for his ability to engage youth, he blends professional journalism expertise with his evangelical calling to deliver transformative messages. As Media and Broadcast Manager at Anglican Missions Africa, Kaindi drives innovative Gospel outreach using media, events, and technology, bridging traditional evangelism with the digital era.

sections.title: Career Highlights
items: Journalism Expertise: Skilled in communication, storytelling, and digital citizenship, emphasizing positive social media use and integrity
Evangelical Ministry: Active Diocesan Evangelist since 2020, excelling in pastoral care, community outreach, and spiritual leadership under the Anglican Church of Kenya, Diocese of Makueni
Leadership in Missions: As Diocesan Missions General Secretary (2023), coordinates outreach programs, fosters partnerships, and guides faith-based development projects
Youth Mobilization: Serves as Youth Pastor at ACK Emmanuel Pro-Cathedral, mentoring and inspiring revival among young believers

sections.title: Educational Background
items: BA in Mass Media and Communication – Mount Kenya University, specializing in Corporate Communications

sections.title: Vision and Goals
sections.content: Kaindi aspires to advance faith-based initiatives through technology and innovation, fostering positive transformation across Africa and beyond.
